resources.newClause: 反馈标签也须全部前提；实际明示共同规则覆盖全篇含例子/反馈/恢复/自检才缩写，非要求以后引用。范围外写足前提。

resources.oldClause: 共同规则完整且明示适用情境、覆盖全文哪些概览/文字/图示及补充/例子/模拟/反馈/恢复/自检/作者核对项；范围内才缩写，范围外写足或指完整规则。
resources.newClause: 共同规则完整且实际声明适用情境与全文覆盖哪些概览/文字/图示及补充/例子/模拟/反馈/恢复/自检/作者核对项；范围内才缩写，范围外写足或明确引用完整规则。“后续须继承”“每条应含前提”等编写要求不是已经建立的本处范围。许可标签、推荐反馈与短句同样须保全部必要前提；不能将部分资格条件当成可执行的充分条件。仅判断条件真假、未附操作许可或字段结果时仍可独立判断。

resources.oldClause: 写反馈先明示共同前提及覆盖分支（标题/表首/相邻说明），范围内可缩写，未覆盖处写足当前态/输入/操作，不借前行/旁表/前例/初始面板。
resources.newClause: 写反馈先实际明示共同前提及覆盖分支（标题/表首/相邻说明），范围内可缩写；未实际建立本处范围则逐条写足当前态/输入/操作，不借前行/旁表/前例/初始面板。“可执行”等推荐短句也是操作结论，必须满足全部前提；只列资格条件时标条件判断，不升级为操作允许。不把拟写要求或出处章节当成已有范围。

independentSemanticReview.finding: A complete common rule may abbreviate only after actual scope is declared for the current content. Instructions to make later sections inherit a rule, general author requirements, or a chapter citation do not themselves establish that current scope. References still permit legitimate scoped shorthand.

Permission labels, recommendation feedback and short sentences retain all source-required current state/input/action premises. Partial qualification facts cannot be silently treated as sufficient permission. Source-defined unconditioned outcomes remain unconditioned under the existing framework.

A question solely about condition truth may be evaluated independently without adding business state. Attaching permission or field results requires the complete applicable source premises. Existing AND/OR handling of known and unknown conditions is unchanged.

Individual direct full reads, received content versus self-report, actual order, truncation supplements and respect for explicit permission denial remain. Generic refusal does not authorize inferring workspace/cache/sandbox/Read causes or switching paths to bypass permission.

Original material, verified background, teaching construction and design judgment remain distinct with actual source location/scope. Conflicts, exceptions, missing information, update replacement/history and minimal missing-material requests remain; no invented topic or implied cross-session synchronization.

Only the explicit guide/new-guide entry; each genuine start still offers 2–3 actually different reader/task/question triplets with tradeoffs, recommendation and reasons. Explicit existing-choice is sufficient; a changed target needs confirmation of its adoption. No second approval/keyword requirement or generation from default, silence, timeout, window loss or unrelated replies; pending proposal persists and no host-window guarantee.

New guide only, Read, Chinese default with original terms, chat copyable text. Revision/comparison/HTML review requests receive the known contract and await an explicit shift to new creation. No HTML/code/pseudocode/graph language/commands/tool production steps/files/writes/image creation/cross-session sends/tool execution even in examples, citations or refusals.

First give the complete source rule unit; fix current state and a single direct action, match all broad/exclusive/prohibited/exception rules before calling a result unknown. Known permission/prohibition is retained independently of unknown post-attempt fields. Unknown fields do not justify invented unchanged/changed values or global unknown conclusions.

Terms, source relations, exclusivity, necessary versus sufficient conditions, source reachable values versus full input domain, numerical units, action occurrence versus condition satisfaction and source-disabled versus unmentioned effects retain their earlier rules. No new domain/example answer is added.

All source restoration actions/objects/fields and real-world limits remain individually attributed. Added UI triggers and effects carry adjacent design identity/reason/scope and remain separate from independently cited source restoration results. Same names/results or whole-page teaching labels cannot establish the same trigger or cover additional results.

Purpose, starting information/current state, explicit operation, changes, result, feedback and recovery remain; shared state/independent scenario/repeat/current-state re-evaluation/combined feedback and partial pending boundaries remain. No fixed chapters, controls or exercise count; static explanation remains allowed.

Teaching checks are guide design, with source-supported premises/location, reason and misconception feedback plus retry. Unreliable/open/missing judgments provide bounded reference, not invented unique answer/automatic grading. No capability score/performance/long-term mastery inference from completion, clicks, confidence or corrected answers.

Whole-delivery review explicitly includes summaries, diagrams, tables, recovery, checks, appendices and author lists. Correct statements elsewhere do not repair the local false premise, field or attribution. Source semantics rather than keyword matching remains the method.

Depth adapts to goals/material complexity; explicit total-visible-text ceiling includes headings/labels/prompts and reserves about20% margin while preserving conditions. Equivalent text/accessibility checks are design intentions, not verified compliance. No effect/mastery improvement or client/UI PASS claims.

limitations: Static review is not evidence that a model will always preserve local premises or scope. Source20 concrete FAIL, original INVALID and partial/not-run evidence remain separate and unchanged.
No installation, consumer preparation, model sampling, client interaction, effect measurement or repository application was authorized or executed for this candidate.
